Definition: a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream, revelation, or oracle
BiblicalUsage: 1) vision; 1a) vision (in ecstatic state); 1b) vision (in night); 1c) vision, oracle, prophecy (divine communication); 1d) vision (as title of book of prophecy)
